title: Sunday · The Carry
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Completely wordless. Six panels. Arthur carrying Barnaby wrapped in a faded wool blanket along the mudflats at low tide.

panels.composition: Panel 1: the mudflats at low tide from the bluff, an immense bruised indigo sky. A single figure far out on the flats, carrying something.

image.prompt: an immense bruised indigo sky over mudflats at low tide seen from a bluff, one small figure far out on the flats carrying something wrapped, wet-on-wet watercolor in Payne's gray and Prussian blue, no words

panels.name: The flats

panels.composition: Panel 2: closer. WOOD walking the wet sand, BARNABY wrapped in a faded wool blanket in his arms, the dog's graying muzzle resting on Wood's collarbone.

image.prompt: a man walking wet sand carrying an old dog wrapped in a faded wool blanket, the dog's gray muzzle resting on his collarbone, desaturated watercolor, no words

panels.name: The blanket

panels.composition: Panel 3: the dog's face against the collarbone. Eyes half open. The wind in the wiry hair at the ear.

image.prompt: close-up of an old dog's face resting against a man's collarbone, eyes half open, wind lifting the wiry hair at its ear, raw umber and gray wash, no words

panels.name: Half open

panels.composition: Panel 4: a massive piece of bleached drift cedar on the flats. Wood sitting on it, the dog held close against the wind. Gulls wheeling in the gray distance.

characters.pose: sitting on the drift log, holding the dog

image.prompt: a man sitting on a massive bleached drift cedar log on the mudflats holding a blanket-wrapped dog close against the wind, gulls wheeling in the gray distance, wet-on-wet watercolor, no words

panels.name: The log

panels.composition: Panel 5: the two of them on the log from behind. The bay mouth. The sky.

image.prompt: a man on a drift log seen from behind holding a wrapped dog, facing the mouth of a bay under a vast bruised sky, no words

panels.name: From behind

panels.composition: Panel 6: the flats again from the bluff, later. The tide coming in. The figure walking back, small, carrying. The sky darker.

image.prompt: the same mudflats from the bluff with the tide returning and the sky darker, one small figure walking back toward shore carrying something wrapped, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Back

art.line: quiet; water bleeding over the ink edge to suggest rain and fading light
art.palette: desaturated wet-on-wet: raw umber, Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw sienna
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for the Sundays

notes: The first of the Silent Sunday Trilogy. Six panels, no words. The drift log from 2007.
